meta.title: BOQ PRs cannot be put in the cart with other PRs
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions screen where the PR combinations are selected.
Use only open PRs, which are eligible for purchase.

args.goal: Select both QA BOQ purchase requisitions, click Purchase Items and purchase them, and stop with the validation message 'Multiple BOQ-based PR cannot be purchased together' visible.

steps.note: Perform the first multi-BOQ selection and observe the product validation.

args.contains: Multiple BOQ-based PR cannot be purchased together

args.goal: Select one QA BOQ purchase requisition and the QA material purchase requisition, click Purchase Items and purchase them, and stop with the validation message 'BOQ-based PR cannot pe purchased along with' visible, preserving the product's 'pe' typo.

steps.note: Perform the mixed BOQ and material PR selection and observe the exact validation wording.

args.contains: BOQ-based PR cannot pe purchased along with
